name: delivery-review
title: Service delivery review
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM services ORDER BY code

sections.title: Changes
sections.sql: SELECT code,title,category,opened_at,merged_at,revision FROM changes WHERE service_id=$1 ORDER BY opened_at

sections.title: Production releases
sections.sql: SELECT code,version,deployed_at,failed_at,recovered_at,is_rework FROM deployments WHERE service_id=$1 AND environment='production' ORDER BY deployed_at

sections.title: Follow-up actions
sections.sql: SELECT code,title,owner,due_on,state,evidence FROM actions WHERE service_id=$1 ORDER BY due_on

name: recovery-record
title: Failed release recovery record
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM deployments WHERE failed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY code

sections.title: Included changes
sections.sql: SELECT c.code,c.title,c.author,c.merged_at FROM changes c JOIN deployment_changes dc ON dc.change_id=c.id WHERE dc.deployment_id=$1 ORDER BY c.code

name: improvement-register
title: Delivery improvement register
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM services ORDER BY code

sections.title: Actions and completion evidence
sections.sql: SELECT code,title,owner,due_on,state,evidence FROM actions WHERE service_id=$1 ORDER BY due_on

sections.title: Review notes
sections.sql: SELECT body,created_at FROM notes WHERE service_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at
